description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ambalayaya, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510085
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (Parcel No. 6 and 7) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner names, identity numbers, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations and title determinations.
